preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of friends N is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The number of slices per pizza K is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be at least 1 for each test case, representing the minimum number of pizzas Chef needs to buy.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == ceil(N / K) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must be the ceiling of N divided by K, ensuring that no friend gets sad.
